visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a close-up of a red vending machine at night. A hand enters the frame, inserting money and selecting a specific can of oden marked 'HOT' for 360 yen. A silver can is seen dropping into the metallic tray. (2) A young male with short dark hair, wearing a grey hoodie, retrieves the can. He moves his hands quickly and blows on them, visually indicating the can't extreme temperature. The setting is a dimly lit urban exterior. (3) The scene shifts to an indoor room with circular-patterned wallpaper. The male sits at a desk, carefully pulling the ring tab on the can. He uses a thin wooden stick to probe the contents. (4) The male uses the wooden stick to lift a large piece of white radish and a tubular fish cake from the light brown broth inside the can. He brings the items to his mouth and eats them with an expressive face. (5) Close-up shots show various ingredients: konjac noodles, quail eggs, and pieces of meat being lifted out. The lighting is bright and indoor. (6) The male looks at the camera, reacting with a surprised facial expression after accidentally poking himself with the stick. He continues to drink the broth directly from the can. (7) A final static shot displays the can resting on a desk next to a menu and a hotel key card.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share the unique experience of purchasing and eating canned oden from a vending machine in Japan. By documenting the entire process from the night-time purchase to the indoor unboxing and tasting, the creator provides an informative and entertaining review of the product's convenience, temperature, and food quality.
